description: This is a fictional interaction between me and a voter – it is heavily based on real conversations I’ve had while going door-to-door, introducing myself to folks in our town. I want you folks reading to feel like you were there – because you were! ‍ ‍ I carry all of you with me when I’m out talk
title: Fully Funded Public Ed… without the tax hikes — Dr. Kathleen Kimball for District 87
